lines.text: Many learners say: Remember me to call her.
Better: Remind me to call her.
Remind! Can you remind me to buy milk?

quiz.stem: Can you ___ me to buy milk?

publish.title: Say "Remind me to call her", not "Remember me to call her"
publish.value: Say "Remind me to call her", not "Remember me to call her". Remind means help someone remember.
